II. PROBLEM FORMULATION

In this section, we formulate the CSPD as an optimization problem which balances the WSR performance and the smoothness of the effective channels.

A. System Model

We consider a single-cell massive multiple-input multipleoutput (MIMO) system consists of a BS equipped with a uniform planar array (UPA) comprising M = M¿Mx antennas, where Mx and Mz denote the number of horizontal and vertical antennas, respectively. The BS serves K singleantenna users. Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) modulation is employed. The number of subcarriers is Ne, and N, subcarriers are allocated for data transmission. Each time slot contains N OFDM symbols, and the channel parameters remain constant within each OFDM symbol but vary across different symbols.
